review_input.original_instruction: Alright, you begin next to a silvery cushioned wall... Oh, man, if you look around... That is... That is like a horrible silver couch has slowly overtaken the room. Like it's spreading to the other surfaces. That is garish and not great to look upon. Alright, well, you'll want to exit this room, through the open door with the circular window in it, and once you've exited, head immediately to the right, into the bathroom... Oh, that is not a bathroom, that is an area behind a bar, excuse me. Once you've just stepped into the area behind the bar, turn around and move towards the painting mounted on the side of the dining table. Once you've taken a step towards that turn left and head across the head of the dining table, towards the back of the bar stools. Continue until you are behind the right-most bar stool, and you're done.
